title: Vallée writes the foreword to the French edition of Virk's book

plain: Jacques Vallée, a computer scientist and veteran UFO researcher, says he wrote the foreword to the French edition of a book by Rizwan Virk, an MIT-trained computer scientist who argues that our world may be a kind of computer simulation. Vallée tells Michels that he read Virk's second book, and then Virk asked him to write the foreword for the French version, "which I did, because by then I was hooked." It shows a long-time UFO researcher putting his name behind the idea that reality may be a simulation.
